scope: Local source reconstruction, isolated five-package builds and file comparison; no remote deployment, publishing, production measurement or source-worktree writes.

originalSource.preservationEvidence: Original checkout HEAD and clean status matched before and after; focused regression also preserves a deliberately dirty source worktree and verifies no target objects were imported into it.

reconstruction.method: Shallow local base fetch into a temporary Git checkout; hash/header validation; git apply --check --index; git apply --index; git write-tree identity verification.

install.dependencyAccess: Public package downloads were allowed for the isolated install; no registry publication occurred.

runtimeAndMetadataComparison.normalization: Package metadata uses JavaScript JSON.stringify with two spaces, a final newline and literal Unicode; scripts/devDependencies removed; selected workspace dependencies remain workspace:*.

focusedChecks.command: bun x --no-install vitest run test/vendor-source.test.ts test/coverage.test.ts

bun x --no-install tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun-types,node --skipLibCheck scripts/vendor-corpus.ts scripts/lib/vendor-source.ts test/vendor-source.test.ts

upstreamRootGates.context: Earlier CHS isolated-clone root checks used CivicSignal dependencies rather than a complete CHS workspace install. These environment-limited attempts do not establish whether full CHS CI passes or fails at the pinned source.

limitations: Source patch reconstructs the pinned tree locally; the isolated commit has not been pushed or published upstream.
The focused source proof and five-package builds do not replace CivicSignal final validation/build/clean-checkout gates or full CHS CI.
No production correctness, freshness, throughput or billing availability conclusion follows from these local checks.
